description: Counters added temporarily to one Mixed-61 2000x2700 run and then reverted. They decided which candidates were worth implementing and which were not.

rejectedCandidates.evidence: 80% of 4621726 constructions repeat, but a fingerprint guard costs almost as much as the key it protects: measured 7-31% saving at an 80% hit rate, inconsistent across sizes
249636 calls against 248610 constructed states is roughly one call per state, so a per-state memo returns nothing
